(ka)༄༅/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥdapal ldan shākya seng ge'i chos kyi rgyal srid mchog la dbang

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i chos kyi rgyal srid mchog la dbang bskur bas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras rkyen rtogs slob mar bcas pas phyag byas shing*// rnam pa kun ldan chos sgra sgrog la dri med legs pa'i blo gros can// 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gang khyod srid gsum 'gro ba'i gtsug na rgyal// ma pham rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar// ji snyed chu klung kun tu zla gzugs bzhin// bgrang yas 'gro ba'i blo mtshor 'char ba yi// pha mtha' bgrang bar nus pa ga la zhig /de lta na yang rta dbyangs dpa' bo dang*// rngog lo rma bya byang chub brtson 'grus sogs// mkhas dang grub par bgrangs pa'i skyes rabs 'phreng*// mang zhig zhal gyis bzhes shing lung du bstan// de las rgyal mtshan tog ltar mngon mtho ba// yongs rdzogs gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta// shākya mchog ldan dri med blo gros zhes// rgyal ba'i bstan la ston pa gnyis par gyur// mi 'jigs bzhi'i khri la gnas bcas te// phyogs las rnam rgyal mkhas grub kun gyi gtso// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa 'dzin pa la// 'gran pa'i zla bral 'dzam gling rgyan gcig nyid// khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam// mkhas dang grub pa'i shing rta che rnams kyi// dgongs pa gcig pa'i lam srol zla med pa// zab mo lta ba chos rnams kun gyi gnad// de nyid phyis 'byung mkhas rlom mang po yis// 'khyog po'i lam du drangs de 'bad pa yis// bkag nas sngon byon gong ma'i lugs srol bzhin// btsugs pa'i mdzad pa rmad byung phul gyi mchog /glegs bam phung po lhun po'i do zla nyid// bstan pa gzugs can bzhin du gnas pa 'di// mthong tshe nges don sems pa'i mkhas pa dag /ngo mtshar bskyed 'gyur de nyid thor bkod pa// bstan bcos mdzad po'i ngo mtshar ston byed bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa bzhi// rdo rje 'chang dngos spyang lung rje dang thams cad mkhyen pa shākya'i mtshan// kun mkhyen chen po don yod dpal ni spyan snga mched dang bcas pa yi// rnam thar rgyas dang rngog lo'i rnam thar yongs 'dzin bstod pa'i tshogs mang po// rgyal dang de sras rnams la bsngags pa'i snyan tshig bstod pa'i 'phreng ba dang*// snga phyi'i dri ba mang po'i lan dang chab shog sna tshogs spel ba'i sde// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rin chen bdun gyis zung 'jug 'khor lo sgyur bar bkur// bde mchog rnam bshad dang po'i sangs rgyas rab tu grub dang gsang 'dus kyi// rnam par thar pa'i sgo brgya phye der rim lnga la sogs nges don bstan// dam tshig rab tu gsal ba'i me long gong ma'i dgongs pa rnam par bkra// chos mtshan brgya dang brgyad pa'i mdzod nas gang 'dod chos kyi re ba skong*// rgyud sde spyi rnams lha mchog bsgrub dang khrid yig mkha' dpyad sgo du ma// mtshan brjod bshad dang gzung sngags mang po bod skad 'gyur sogs sngags kyi sde// dbu ma'i byung tshul yid bzhin lhun po 'jug sgo gsum pa'i lam nas bltas// bzhed tshul rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi 'phreng ba lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad// sbyor ba'i ṭīkka gnad kyi sgron mes byams chos nges don rab tu gsal// lung dang rigs pa'i rol mtsho che las zur 'debs bzhi'i chu bo 'bab// log rtog brag ri phye mar 'thag la thal ngag dbang po'i rdo rje 'bar// lugs gnyis rnam par phye ba'i nges don lung chos rgya mtsho'i snying por dril// sngon med nyi mas gsal bar byas pa'i byams chos lam gyi bang rim la// nye bar 'dzegs nas dga' ldan gnas su zab zhi spros bral bdud rtsi brnyes// rtsa 'jug gnyis dang chos dbyings bstod pa byang chub sems 'grel rnam bshad che// gzhan gyi nor pa'i rtsa ba bgrangs byas dngos gnas gsal ba brgya dang brgyad// de 'joms byed pa'i lung rigs stong phrag thun du sdebs pa che chung gnyis// dbu ma'i dka' 'grel kun da'i dga' ston nges don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa can// tshangs pa'i 'khor los gzhan gyi rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'khrul pa ma lus dral// tshad ma'i chos 'byung dpyod ldan dga' byed rnam bshad kun bzang rol mtshor 'khyil// dka' 'grel rigs pa'i snang ba 'bar bas rtog ge'i 'khrul pa ma lus 'joms// rtog ge'i snying po che chung gnyis de sde bdun bde mdzod lde mig can// rig gter grub mtha' nor bu'i mdzod de sde bdun ngag gi rol mtsho yin// sems tsam gsal ba'i me long dang ni khyab 'jug mdung thung rab tu bkra// 'dul ba'i dka' 'grel nyi ma'i shing rta ba dan dkar po'i phreng bas mdzes// theg pa gsum gyi 'dul ba'i bslab bya dus tshigs bslab bya mdor bsdus pa// 'bel gtam rnam nges bsnyen gnas cho ga gzhi gsum bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho gang*// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng bye brag bshad pa'i rgya mtshor 'khyil// ldan rtsis zhugs gnas grub mtha' bsdus dang rab dbye gsum gyi dgongs pa bkral// legs bshad gser gyi thur mas phye bas pad dkar mig gi dga' ston mthong*// bsdus don nor bu'i phreng ba spel nas kha skong lung rig rnga dbyangs sgrags// sher snying mdo dang bzang po spyod pa byams pa'i smon lam smon bla'i mdo// smon lam bdun cu sum rtags gnyis dang smra sgo mtshon cha zhib mor phye// sdebs sbyor me tog chun po khyer nas mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgor son te// tshig rgyan snyan ngag me long phyis par dbyangs can ngag gi dngos kun gsal// spring yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa de dang blo sbyong brgyad ma rnam par phye// de ltar rnam par bshad rgya che de bsngo ba yon bshad 'bras bur smin// de ltar 'di ni dus gsum rgyal kun gyi// bstan pa'i snying dang snying po srog gi zungs// gzhom med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs chen po ste// thar 'dod kun gyi gnyer byar 'os pa'i blos// sde snod gsum dang rgyu sde chen po bzhi// rig gnas lnga yi zlos gar sgyur ba'i tshal// thub bstan gser mdog can gyi chos grwa che'i// bla brang bkra shis brtsegs pa 'di nyid nas// rgya nag mi dbang chen po'i mchod pa'i gnas// gnam mchod ban dhe mchog gi dbon po ni// mchod yon gnyis kas bstsal ba'i las ka can// khri dpon dpal 'byor bzang po'i rigs brgyud las// rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs gyur nas// mdo rgyud gzhung mang thos pa'i blo mig can// dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin dpon slob kyis// lhag bsam rnam dag gus pa'i yid kyis bzhengs// yi ger 'bri po snye mo chu shul ba// kar rgyal zhes bya kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi// do zlar mkhas pa'i skye bos bgrang bya ba// de yis gtso byas mkhan pa nor ching dang*// smyug thogs rgyal po dbu mdzad tshe 'phel sogs// mkhas pa bcu phrag gcig dang gsum gyis ni// 'jal byed phyed bcas drug la legs par bsgrubs// zhu dag sde snod 'dzin pa mang pos bgyis// rgyu tshogs rgyags yon kun tu dril ba la// nas khal stong phrag gsum dang rgya phrag bzhi// gsum bcas bcu las legs par grub pa yi// dge de rnam dkar kun dang bsdoms pa'i mthu// bstan pa'i srog shing paṇa chen yab sras dang*// yongs 'dzin karma bzang po la sogs pa'i// zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// khyab bdag rigs brgya'i gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'dzin// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' snying po'i zhabs brtan zhing*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'di nyid la// rgyu dngos cung zad tsam zhig 'dres pa dang*// rig byed mkhan dang las byed la sogs pa// mdor na 'di la 'brel pa thogs pa yi// sems can rnams dang pha mas thog drangs pa'i// 'gro ba kun gyis byang chub myur thob shog

/de ma thob kyi tshe rabs thams cad du// bde 'gro rigs gzugs 'byor pa shes rab che// mchog dang ldan zhing yongs 'dzin dam pa yis// rjes bzung theg chen chos la spyod par shog /bdag ni skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// 'khor lo sdom pa kun dga' snying po'i zhabs// spyi bo'i rgyan las nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// myur bde'i lam las myur du mchog grub shog /gnas skabs 'dir yang 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen chos dang mthun par 'grub pa dang*// 'chi tshe dga' ldan gnas su nges skye zhing*// ma pham zhal mthong gsung la spyod par shog /khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i ring lugs pa// paṇa chen shākya mtshan mchog ldan pa yi// bstan pa phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas 'di// phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /thub bstan gser mdog can gyi chos grwa 'di// tshul ldan mang thos 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyis// rab tu gang zhing thugs mthun bshad bsgrub kyi// bstan pa rin chen mchog tu rgyas par shog /'jig rten kun yang dge ba'i bdag 'bras ky-is// rdzogs ldan dus bzhin kun tu gang ba dang*// tshor dang lta ba'i dbang gis mi 'khrug par// mchog tu bde zhing chos la spyod par shog /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa// rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyis// glegs bam 'di rnams bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzod// bkra shis gang zhig ma pham byams mgon thugs rje'i 'phrul// 'dzam gling sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal du legs shar ba// chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol// bkra shis gang zhig rtsa brgyud bla mas byin rlob cing*// sangs rgyas bden gsungs dam chos mchog rab mi g.yo ba// dge 'dun bden pa'i lam la gnas pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol// bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan// 'phrin las rgyas shing dge 'dun rgya mtsho thugs mthun la// chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//

//saddharmāsras bhū ti bha wa ti// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
